title: Pseudo-classes and Pseudo-elements
description: Master the use of pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements to style elements dynamically and target specific parts of the document.

lessons.title: Introduction to Pseudo-classes
lessons.content: Pseudo-classes allow you to define a special state of an element, like :hover or :focus.

lessons.title: Common Pseudo-classes
Structural Pseudo-classes (:first-child, :nth-child)
Introduction to Pseudo-elements
lessons.content: Pseudo-elements let you style specific parts of an element, like ::before and ::after for inserting content.

lessons.title: Styling First Letter and First Line
Browser Compatibility and Best Practices
lessons.content: Most pseudo-classes and elements are well supported, but testing is important. Avoid excessive use for performance.
